aiGuidance.purpose: The stable id that joins this help to the UI: components declare it with use:feature, agents name it in ui_highlight.
aiGuidance.extraction: A lowercase dotted slug: <editor>.<feature> (essay.add-paragraph) or shell.<feature> for UI every editor shares (shell.agent-panel).
aiGuidance.negativeGuidance: Never change an id once used; never reuse one for a different feature.
